issues.issue: Whether the adult claimants' forced abortion and sterilization account is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimants allege a forced IUD, two forced abortions, sterilization notices, fines and PSB damage to home.
issues.result_text: Both adult claimants not credible; abortion, notice and fine documents found not genuine.

issues.issue: Whether the admitted false travel-route statements to CBSA undermine credibility
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the agent advised them to make false statements about their travel route.
issues.result_text: Admitted lie about travel route; negative credibility inference drawn and claimant not believed.

issues.issue: Whether returning to China with more than one child exposes claimants to persecution
issues.applicant_position: Claimants say they would be persecuted returning to China with two Canadian and two Chinese children.
issues.result_text: Despite the one-child law, no serious possibility of persecution; children born abroad largely forgiven.
